seriesTitle: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Twenty years after a career-ending scandal, former running back Reggie Dinkins enlists filmmaker Arthur Tobin to make a documentary he hopes will rehabilitate his image.

episodes.title: Nittany Means Big
episodes.summary: Tobin spends the day with Monica and uncovers the truth about Reggie's famous food poisoning game. Reggie struggles to apologize to Brina.

episodes.title: Put It on Your Cabbage!
episodes.summary: Tobin urges Reggie to leave the house and face the outside world. Monica learns there's more to Brina than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Save the Cat
episodes.summary: Reggie thinks finding his former coach's lost cat will help him get into the Hall of Fame. Monica gets back in the dating game.

episodes.title: You May Hug Your Hero
episodes.summary: Reggie and Monica restart their youth football camp and face off against their old rivals, Jerry and Tisha Basmati.

episodes.title: Dr. Watson's Dad
episodes.summary: When one of Reggie's most prized possessions goes missing, he must gather all the suspects and uncover whodunnit.

episodes.title: The World is Full of Beaks
episodes.summary: Tobin tries to keep his personal life separate from the documentary, but Reggie doesn't make it easy on him. Monica helps Brina with her music career.

episodes.title: The Loyalty Swamp
episodes.summary: Tobin's past comes back to haunt him. Reggie and Brina struggle to set a wedding date.

episodes.title: Mischief and Memories
episodes.summary: The Dinkins family bands together for their annual push to get Reggie into the Hall of Fame, but Jerry Basmati stands in their way.

episodes.title: A Real Cinderello Story
episodes.summary: Monica tries to sign an exciting new prospect. Unexpectedly, Jerry Basmati takes revenge on Reggie.
